meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of what law-firm websites' crawler files and raw pages said when read. A rule in such a file is what the file says; it does not show what any AI tool does, and nothing here measures whether a firm appears in AI answers. The counts describe no firm's quality.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

changes.title: Law-firm websites and AI crawlers first published
changes.summary: Crawler-file rules for eight named AI crawlers and controls, the home-page text a reader gets before JavaScript runs, FAQPage and Organization markup, snippet limits, apex and www hosts and Spanish pages on 44,118 US law-firm websites: 2.2% block the home page for at least one named AI crawler or control.
